ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white surface comprising approximately 85% of the visible area, sharply contrasted by low-intensity black perimeter borders and scattered dark circular pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across the central and upper regions of both lobes; low-intensity black pigment forms a continuous band along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; multiple discrete circular dark-intensity focal spots (mottling) are distributed across the white field, with higher density on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees, showing significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical jagged topography; the left lobe displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; the right lobe features a prominent high-amplitude notch-like indentation approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning into sharp, upward-swept terminal tips; leading edges exhibit a moderate, consistent linear convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular dark-ringed rosette structures concentrated on the left lobe and lower-central region; high-intensity white pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized specifically at the extreme terminal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct diagonal dark linear disruption on the mid-right lobe; a series of parallel vertical rake marks visible on the lower-right quadrant near the peduncle insertion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss (notch) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive scarring and dark pigmentation disruption at the fluke-peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentric 'bullseye' pigmentation markers localized in the medial region of the left lobe.
